title: How playing an instrument benefits your brain - Anita Collins
summary: A short TED-Ed animated lesson by Anita Collins on what happens in the brain when people play a musical instrument. It argues that playing engages many brain areas at once, like a full-body workout, with long-term benefits.
why: Cited as a source for claims that learning an instrument connects both brain hemispheres, though some commenters note they haven't verified it.

quote.text: There is an observable difference in brain activity between playing an instrument and actively listening
